reason: Both answers reach the right conclusion: don't use full event sourcing, use CRUD plus an append-only ledger, and consider buying billing. B leads with buy-vs-build, which is the strongest advice. B also adds concrete ES risks that A lacks: replay re-triggering side effects, pricing churn forcing permanent upcasters, and finance needing zero-lag SQL reads. It also names the resume-driven trap, which addresses the enthusiasm red flag. A has a good hybrid design and flags the enthusiasm too, but it puts "why build at all" last. B's "≥50% of team" figure is unsupported, but that is minor.
